rule_or_requirement: A faster pixel-only candidate must retain valid completion on independent held-out cells.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, contiguous visible asphalt clearance, road-center motion, obstacle pixels, rendered speed, and fixed stable actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Freeze the tune-winning road-clearance gas floor without modifying any source or parameter.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected control's finish count across twelve reserved held-out cells, then lower median finished lap time and no invalid actions.
control: Exact-hash selected full-road-guard actor on each held-out cell.
falsifier: Lower finish count, invalid action, or tied completion without a lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Tracks 1–3 × seeds 328–331, candidate and control on each of twelve cells, 24 episodes at most 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 1800-second registered limit, no source change, no confirmation/blind use and no website action.
